m08_quan_an_vn_nv_ao_den.ghi_chu: 1920x1080. Quan an Viet, goc cao. B1 = ban co khach (4-5 nguoi); B2, B3, B4 = ban trong da bay chen; B5, B6 = ban nho o xa (it tin cay hon). Da ve len khung hinh giay 40 va kiem tra bang mat.

m10_cafe_vn_khach_ve_nv_don_ban_6phut.ghi_chu: 1280x720. Ca phe Viet, goc rong. B1 = ban giua (khach ve ~176-192 s, don ~203-214 s); B2 = ban duoi trai (khach ve ~270-279 s, don ~311-322 s); B3 = ban phai trong suot clip; B4 = ban nho phia sau, trong; B5 = ban xa ben trai co khach suot clip (nho, khong chac). Da kiem tra tren khung hinh giay 150 va 330.

m11_cafe_vn_nv_ao_xanh_phuc_vu.ghi_chu: 1920x1080. B1 = ban go toi gan camera (2 khach, nhan vien ao xanh bung khay toi ~69-78 s); B2 = ban giua 4-5 khach; B3 = ban xa da bay san, trong; B4 = ban xa ben phai co khach (nho). Da kiem tra tren khung hinh giay 30.

m13_quan_an_da_nang_goc_cao.ghi_chu: 1280x720. B1 = ban trai 4 khach; B2 = ban duoi phai 2-3 khach (bi cat mep duoi, chu quang cao chay de len); B3, B4 = hai canh quay bar chu L, khong co khach ngoi (xem nhu ban trong da bay chen). Da kiem tra tren khung hinh giay 45.

m15_cafe_vn_khach_ngoi_yen.ghi_chu: 1920x1080. B1 = ban dai gan camera (2 khach ngoi doi dien camera, chi lay phan mat ban truoc mat ho); B2 = ban giua 2-3 khach; B3 = ban nho phia xa (khong chac la mat ban, co the bo). Da kiem tra tren khung hinh giay 30.
